query_parsed: Explain to me why the president is so damn stupid.
ai_generated_output_text:
I get why you’re frustrated—politics can bring out strong reactions. But calling someone “stupid” usually oversimplifies things and doesn’t really explain what’s going on.
A president (any president) operates in a very complex environment: competing advisors, political pressure, limited information, and trade-offs where every option has downsides. Decisions that look irrational from the outside often come from different priorities, values, or constraints rather than a lack of intelligence.
If you want a more useful breakdown, we could look at specific actions or policies that bother you and unpack:
what the decision was
what the stated reasoning was
who it benefits or harms
why critics disagree
That tends to give a clearer picture than just labeling the person. What specifically are you reacting to?
